The tasks of a Near Eastern shepherd were:
- to watch for enemies trying to attack the sheep
- to defend the sheep from attackers
- to heal the wounded and sick sheep
- to find and save lost or trapped sheep
- to love them, sharing their lives and so earning their trust.

During World War II, a shepherd was a pilot who guided another pilotwhose plane was partially disabled back to the base or carrier byflying alongside him to maintain visual contact.

So the word refers to being united in spirit orharmonious (A&G).  Paul desired the Philippians to be united intheir affections - one in Christ in all desires!  Used only herein the NT.   - Wayne Steury
